factSources: 68M 17-inch, staggered (7.5J/8.5J), five pairs of spokes: blog `telling-e46-wheels-apart` (S1 catalogue mirror, MEDIUM; spoke count from the canonical photo, S6). · 68M = M Sport package II wheel on Sedan, Touring, Coupé, Convertible: blog `e46-m-sport-package-ii` (S2 German price lists, HIGH). · Slide 2 car wears 68M: `e46build-agent1/docs/research/t085-look-images/README.md` (PO check 2026-10-13). · One M front cover for every Sedan and Touring, no facelift split: blog `e46-genuine-m-front-bumper` (S1 catalogue, MEDIUM). · Code 338 in the German price lists: blog `e46-m-sport-package-ii` (S2, HIGH). Launched 14 May 2001: same article (S1 BMW press release, HIGH). "Laser" cloth with Alcantara sport seats: same article (S1 + S2, HIGH). · 135M and M3 on slide 1 are named only, with no claim attached.
reviewNotes: the coordinator's idea included the M3 steering wheel. I left it out because our steering pictures are isolated cut-outs or an empty cockpit, so no "part on the car" picture exists, and P2 already showed that the seat stage doesn't show a specific M wheel.
